roles.lone_mafia: 🔪 You are on your own now.

civilian.name: Civilian
civilian.intro: You are a Civilian. Sleep at night; by day, hunt the mafia with words and votes.
civilian.goal: Goal: vote out every member of the mafia.
civilian.tips: Trust your instincts: track votes, claims and who shifts blame.

detective.name: Detective
detective.intro: You are the Detective. Each night, inspect one player: mafia or innocent?
detective.goal: Goal: learn the truth and convince the town — without revealing yourself too early.
detective.tips: Check quietly and remember results — you are the mafia's top target.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.intro: You are the Doctor. Each night you may save one player from death.
doctor.goal: Goal: survive until the town wins, healing wisely (self-heal once).
doctor.self_heal_note: You can heal yourself only once per game.
doctor.tips: You can heal yourself only once per game — spend it at the right night.

escort.name: Escort
escort.intro: You are the Escort. Each night you visit a player and keep them busy: their night action fails.
escort.goal: Goal: survive until the town wins and ruin the night visitors' plans.
escort.tips: Blocking a killer saves lives; blocking an ally of town helps the mafia.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.intro: You are the Bodyguard. Each night you guard one player: if they are attacked, you die in their place.
bodyguard.goal: Goal: protect key townsfolk at the cost of your own life.
bodyguard.tips: Guard likely targets: if attacked, you die so they live.

witness.name: Witness
witness.intro: You are the Witness. If a murder happens at night, you see the name of one of the attackers.
witness.goal: Goal: pass the truth to the town — and stay alive.
witness.tips: Stay alive and quiet — one night may reveal an attacker's name.

journalist.name: Journalist
journalist.intro: You are the Journalist. Each night you learn a player's exact role.
journalist.goal: Goal: collect the scoop and publish it at the perfect moment.
journalist.tips: Exact-role checks expose the godfather and turncoat instantly.

elder.name: Elder
elder.intro: You are the Elder. The first night attack cannot kill you — experience beats the knife.
elder.goal: Goal: lead the town to victory by example.
elder.tips: The first attack against you fails — never count on surviving a second.

bomzh.name: Vagrant
bomzh.intro: You are the Vagrant. You have no home — night kills can't touch you. Healing has no effect on you.
bomzh.goal: Goal: make it to the finale. The mafia will have to come for you in daylight.
bomzh.tips: Night kills can't touch you; the mafia must come for you by day.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.intro: You are the Sniper. One bullet: during the day you may shoot any player.
sniper.goal: Goal: don't miss. A bullet into a civilian is a gift to the mafia.
sniper.tips: One bullet, fired at will by day. Shoot only when you are sure.

mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.intro: You are Mafia. At night, choose a victim with your teammates; by day, act innocent.
mafia.goal: Goal: reach parity by vote or by knife.
mafia.tips: Agree on a single target with the family and keep your cover by day.

godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.intro: You are the Godfather. Head of the family: your word breaks mafia ties. The detective reads you as innocent.
godfather.goal: Goal: lead the family to victory while staying “clean” in the town's eyes.
godfather.tips: You break ties and give the final word; checks read you innocent.

turncoat.name: Turncoat
turncoat.intro: You are the Turncoat. You're on the mafia team, but detective checks always show you as innocent.
turncoat.goal: Goal: turn the town's trust into the family's weapon.
turncoat.tips: A full family member whom alignment checks always read as innocent.

maniac.name: Maniac
maniac.intro: You are the Maniac. You play alone: every night you can kill anyone — even mafia.
maniac.goal: Goal: be the last one standing.
maniac.tips: Every night is yours — kill anyone, but you win only alone at the end.

bandit.name: Lone Bandit
bandit.intro: You are the Lone Bandit. A maniac's knife at night plus one bullet for a daytime shot.
bandit.goal: Goal: be the last one standing.
bandit.tips: Kills at night like a maniac plus one daytime bullet.

satanist.name: Satanist
satanist.intro: You are the Satanist. You do nothing at night. You win if the mafia sacrifices you — kills you at night.
satanist.goal: Goal: die by the mafia's knife. Satanism needs no meaning.
satanist.tips: No action at all — if the mafia kills you at night, you win instantly.

onb.welcome_body: Play classic social deduction right in your group chats. Tap 📖 Rules to learn how to play, or pick your language below.

basics.title: The Basics
basics.body: Two teams play against each other: the minority Mafia and the majority Innocents (Civilians and power roles). The game alternates two phases: • 🌃 Night — the city sleeps, mafia choose a victim, power roles use their abilities. • ☀️ Day — the town discusses what happened and votes to exile one player. Innocents win by exiling every mafia member; mafia win when they equal or outnumber the living innocents.

roles_overview.title: Roles at a Glance
roles_overview.body: 🙂 Civilian — no night ability; fights mafia with words and votes. 🔪 Mafia — each night agrees on one victim; hides behind innocence by day. 💉 Doctor — each night heals one player, protecting them from the mafia kill. 🔍 Detective — each night checks one player: mafia or innocent? Other roles may appear in some sets — see the role encyclopedia on the last page.

night.title: Night Phase
night.body:
At night active roles receive a private DM with their action menu:
• Mafia jointly pick a player to kill.
• The Doctor picks a player to heal — including, once per game, themselves.
• The Detective picks a player to check and learns their alignment.

If the doctor healed the mafia's target, nobody dies. At dawn the town learns who — if anyone — was killed.

voting.title: Day & Voting
voting.body: By day everyone discusses and then votes: who is mafia? • The player with the most votes is exiled and their role is revealed. • On a tie — a revote among the tied players. • If the revote ties again — no one is exiled that day. You may abstain. Votes are secret until the ballot closes.

discipline.title: Discipline: AFK, Skips, Freeze
discipline.body: Leaving the vote uncast counts as a skip. Sleepyheads who miss a vote get a 😴 badge in the game feed. Miss 2 games in a row without voting — your participation is frozen for 15 minutes. Play any game to the end and the counter resets. Please plan to stay for the whole game before joining.
